_comment: Blocked independent C-first B82 hero-attacker setup miss. Seed 8806420 and the 2032 date were selected independently to request a controlled werejackal hero form before creating a hostile newt. polyself.c:polyself only bypasses polyok for a were beast when iswere is true and were_beastie(mntmp) matches the existing u.ulycn; this uninfected Wizard cannot enter the no-poly werejackal form. The remaining input was consumed by the repeated controlled-form prompt and transformed the hero into a newt, so the scratch C artifact is setup history, not a runtime witness.
